## unity command

- CLI version: `1.0.0-beta.9`
- Supported platforms: linux, macos, windows
- Aliases: `cmd`

Execute commands on connected Unity Editor instances, or list available commands

### Usage

`unity command|cmd [options] [command] [args...]`

### Subcommands

None.

| Argument | Required | Repeatable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | True | False | Command to execute on Unity Editor (omit to list available commands) |
| `args` | True | False | Arguments for the command |
